_comment: Verified facts the 'factual-source' carousel taste may open with, e.g. 'Google says ...'. A model must NEVER make up who said what, so the taste only runs when a fact is listed here. Add only facts you have checked yourself, with the exact claim wording, the source's name and a link. Example entry (delete the word EXAMPLE when real): {"id": "example", "claim": "exact wording of the claim", "source_name": "Name of the source", "source_url": "https://...", "as_of": "2026-10-26", "services": ["chatbot"]}. Leave services empty to allow every service.
